# Pillars and indicators {#sec-pillars}

The framework groups indicators into two families — **exposure & susceptibility** (what raises risk) and **agency-resilience** (what protects it) — following the logic introduced in @sec-resilience.

> Risk is read as **Exposure × Susceptibility ÷ Agency-Resilience**.

Every indicator is defined once, in the machine-readable registry at `analysis/registry/indicators.yml`, which drives both the computation (@sec-constructing) and the codebook (see the appendix). The table below is generated from that registry, so it can never disagree with the code.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-indicators
#| tbl-cap: "Draft indicator set (generated from the registry)."
#| echo: false
import yaml, pandas as pd
with open("analysis/registry/indicators.yml") as f:
    reg = yaml.safe_load(f)
df = pd.DataFrame(reg["indicators"])[["id", "name", "pillar", "direction", "weight"]]
df.columns = ["id", "indicator", "pillar", "direction", "weight"]
df
```
